name: PlayAdapt
description: Theme-adaptive player enhancement engine for Jellyfin official client with zero disk footprint.
overview: PlayAdapt dynamically inspects any active Jellyfin theme, anchoring custom player features seamlessly into place with native styling, geometry, and glassmorphism.

versions.changelog: v1.0.6.0: Full compatibility for Jellyfin Desktop 2.0 (Qt6/MpvQt) & Jellyfin Media Player: Universal playbackManager/player timing queries (currentTime & getCurrentTicks) bypassing missing HTML5 video elements; Fully qualified URL resolution via ApiClient.getUrl() eliminating local file:/// and app:/// desktop fetch failures; Multi-path ApiClient discovery across ServerConnections and connectionManager; Dynamic playbackstart and mediastreamschange auto-sync; Fixed viewport subtitle overlay rendering.

v1.0.5.0: Enhanced secondary subtitle button distinction & layout: Added AnchorSlot.AfterSubtitles to position secondary subtitles directly adjacent to the primary subtitle button (eliminating favorite button separation); Added 'translate' icon with a distinct '2' corner badge and theme-reactive active lighting for unmistakable visual distinction; Added badge support to ComponentFactory.

v1.0.4.0: Complete removal of all Web Audio API and audio boost capabilities; Added isolated Dual Subtitle (Secondary Subtitle) engine with strict Master Toggle (defaults to OFF), guaranteed zero interference with primary/ASS subtitle rendering, pure clear-text parsing (stripping all ASS/HTML typesetting tags), fixed-place viewport placement (Top Center, Middle, Above Controls), font sizing, and visual styling.

v1.0.3.0: Fixed screenshot capture & file download on Firefox Linux (replaced restricted data URIs with Blob URLs and dispatchEvent); Added dynamic HDR Tone Mapping badge (e.g., Tone Map QSV) when HDR media is transcoded to SDR; Added Tone Mapping toggle in floating tags menu.

v1.0.2.0: Audio vs Video transcode breakdown (e.g., Direct Stream · Audio QSV, Transcode · Video, Transcode · A+V); Original codec transcode arrow indicator (e.g., HEVC ➔ H.264 · 1080p FHD, OPUS ➔ AAC); Fixed bitrate buffer freezing and spikes (decays to 0.0 Mbps when buffered/idle); New toggle between nominal Stream Bitrate and live Network Activity in tag preferences.

v1.0.1.0: Real-time network throughput bitrate monitor; Smart downward menu positioning for top HUD; Accurate playback speed menu dynamic checkmarks; Direct Events & API stream codec discovery (OPUS, FLAC, TrueHD Atmos, AV1, HEVC); Toast notifications for frame capture.

Initial Release: Theme-Adaptive Player Engine with real-time theme inspection, spatial layout resolver, native component factory, admin configuration dashboard, and showcase aspects (playback speed, clean frame screenshot, stream stats HUD, and dialogue audio boost).
